name: Coal tit
lateFeature: Two pale wing bars, nape patch and crisp dark primary structure
anatomyNotes: Small pointed bill and white nape mark distinguish the coal tit. Buff breast and grey-green wing are separated from strong black bib; short tail sweeps lower-left.
